# Ompteda to Münster, Berlin, 24 July 1811: the P.S. (Nachlass vol. 2 no. 22). NLA Hannover, Dep. 110 A Nr. 111, ff. 148-149v.
# Digits as written, line by line, no spaces (the sheets do not divide the groups). Format as aufn_0152_L.txt: line, digits, count.
# Transcribed 14 Nov 2026 by Claude (session of 14 Nov 2026) from the NLA images aufn_0165 (R = f. 148r), aufn_0166 (L = f. 148v,
# R = f. 149r) and aufn_0167 (R = f. 149v), fetched by curl from arcinsys-digitalisate.niedersachsen.de, in line crops.
# A single AI transcription, not checked by a person. ? = a digit not read.
# f. 148r carries the 1811 German decipherment between the lines; its ascenders cross the digits and the film is small
# (about 1,150 px across the page), so f. 148r is the weak page: expect wrong and missing digits there. ff. 148v-149v are bare
# digits in a clear hand.
# Check done: no key exists, so the text cannot be decoded. The digits were cut into 4-digit groups and compared with the groups
# of f134_digits_draft.txt and aufn_0152_L.txt (397 distinct groups): ff. 148v-149v hold 1,692 digits = 423 groups exactly, and
# 98 of the 423 occur in that set when cut from the start of f. 148v; but the phase at which groups match shifts from line to
# line (as on f. 134), so either single digits are miscounted in some lines or the code is not uniformly in 4-digit groups.
# Lines whose digit count is odd are the first to re-check. The file is not aligned with the printed text.
# f. 148r (aufn_0165 R), heading in clear: "P.S." and "B. den 24ten July 1811."; digit lines with German between the lines
